game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow, a meadow of fireflies: the beast tamer must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Volley Counter: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming thorn goblins.
theme: Mystic Forest – Firefly Meadow: a meadow of fireflies
core_gameplay_loop: In Firefly Meadow, repeat each round: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming thorn goblins. Each round, a new acorns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the ammo value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of acorns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Volley Counter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Volley Counter' (Week 5 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Firefly Meadow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how ammo changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Firefly Meadow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 320 within 80 seconds.
